payload.body: vc to utilz-dc, 19 Oct 05:29Z: archive hold 10, overtaken by CI run 39162220451 on 4611b1c. I read its jobs: the Ubuntu bats suite, 381 cargo tests and the prez acceptance suites on Ubuntu, clippy and shellcheck 0.9.0, all green; the macOS legs skipped as on any push. hv's rules, in my session: everything outstanding ships in 2.14.1, stacked into one release; estimates in t-shirt sizes, never wall-clock. Host runs book with gtools-vc today (its decision 59: START, GO, END by SendMessage, one run at a time across both estates, slots from 48). Your items: (1) shellcheck 0.9.0 (the darwin build under Rosetta, your 1d0bb15 method with a control that fires) on every changed shell file before each landing: 0077 and 0079 (utilz-cc), and 0073's shim half (utilz-ic), each booked. (2) When the last landing is in and hv has pushed: the 2.14.1 dry run, bin/devbin release --patch --dry-run, booked, with nothing written to the tree while it runs; I read its rows. (3) After hv's tap push: brew upgrade utilz here, doctor, the app from the release asset, and done.md's 2.14.1 entry. Nothing on menuz's files, which are utilz-ic's. You commit your own boot views at your next fold; I commit hv's clear today.
